unit.why: A short anecdote, told by R. Yitzhak of Neshchiz, about R. Liber of Berditchev hosting a guest at night and making his bed himself, with a pointed reply.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הה״ק מהר״י זצ״ל מנשחיז שהיה
stories.summary_en: R. Liber of Berditchev takes in a late-night guest after the fair and makes the bed himself; when the guest protests, he answers that he is making it for himself, meaning he is preparing himself for the world to come.

tags.why: The anecdote exists to show R. Liber's hospitality and piety.

quotes: וקיבלו ר׳ ליבר כדרך הכנסות אורחים
tags.why: Hospitality is the virtue at the centre of the story.

quotes: והציע לו בעצמו מטה לשכוב עליה
למה זה מעלתו בעצמו מטריח א״ע להציע לי
tags.why: A respected man makes up the guest's bed himself.

quotes: וקיבלו ר׳ ליבר כדרך הכנסות אורחים
tags.why: Hosting a guest is a form of kindness close to charity.
The point of his reply is preparing for the world to come.
